summary: Generate a Jira-ready task from a local product brief
context: Product ideas currently become vague Jira tasks that require repeated clarification before engineering can begin. The first vertical slice should prove that a bounded AutoGen Product Owner can turn a local brief into one reviewable, schema-valid task without changing Jira.
user_story: As a product owner, I want a local brief converted into a reviewable Jira task so that engineering refinement starts from clear and testable requirements.
desired_outcome: A developer can run one local command and receive a structured Jira task in JSON and readable Markdown, together with a deterministic Definition of Ready result.
business_value: Reduce refinement time and prevent avoidable implementation rework caused by vague work items.
scope: Load and validate a local ProductBrief JSON file
Use one bounded AutoGen AssistantAgent session to create a JiraTaskDraft
Validate the structured output with Pydantic
Evaluate the draft with deterministic Definition of Ready checks
Render the draft locally without writing to Jira
non_goals: Calling Jev in the first vertical slice

acceptance_criteria.when: the draft command runs with valid model configuration
acceptance_criteria.evidence: an automated schema-validation test and a saved JSON artifact

acceptance_criteria.then: every failed check is returned by name and a failing gate uses a non-zero exit code
acceptance_criteria.evidence: unit tests for passing and failing drafts

acceptance_criteria.then: no Jira create or update request is sent
acceptance_criteria.evidence: an integration test with a mocked Jira transport

acceptance_criteria.then: Ruff, mypy, and pytest pass on supported Python versions

test_plan: Unit-test passing and failing Definition of Ready evaluations
Mock the Jira transport and prove that dry-run performs no request
Run Ruff, mypy, and pytest locally and in CI
risks: Model output may fail schema validation and must not produce partial output
Prompt quality may vary across models and needs a public evaluation dataset
rollout: Review generated tasks manually before enabling Jira publication
success_metrics: The example brief produces one valid task draft in a bounded run
All deterministic quality checks and repository tests pass
Zero Jira writes occur in the first vertical slice
open_questions: Which evaluation dataset should become the public benchmark for task quality?
Which Jira fields beyond summary and description should be supported next?
